classes.name: Statins
classes.description: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors: atorvastatin (Lipitor), rosuvastatin (Crestor, Ezallor), simvastatin (Zocor), pravastatin, lovastatin (Altoprev), pitavastatin (Livalo, Zypitamag), fluvastatin, and statin combinations (Vytorin, Roszet).
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill that lowers LDL cholesterol.

classes.name: Ezetimibe & other non-statin oral agents
classes.description: Non-statin oral LDL-lowering agents: ezetimibe (Zetia), bempedoic acid (Nexletol) and bempedoic acid/ezetimibe (Nexlizet).
classes.plainDescription: A cholesterol pill used with or instead of a statin.

classes.name: PCSK9 inhibitors & siRNA
classes.description: Injectable PCSK9-pathway agents: evolocumab (Repatha), alirocumab (Praluent), inclisiran (Leqvio).
classes.plainDescription: An injection every 2 weeks to 6 months that strongly lowers LDL cholesterol.

records.verificationNote: Read PDL p. 10 by column x-position: atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, pravastatin, simvastatin and lovastatin generics are PREFERRED. Atorvastatin 20 mg is the common moderate-intensity starting dose. PA criteria p. 23 show quantity limits on the preferred statins with no PA. The number of the quantity limit is not printed in the extracted text. Brand statins are NON-PREFERRED (PDL p. 10); the general lipid non-preferred rule (PA criteria p. 21) requires trial and failure of 2 preferred agents, which is recorded as a step rather than PA. Representative list of brand products, not exhaustive. Statin combinations (Vytorin, Caduet, Atorvaliq) are not single-agent alternatives. [Sonnet check 2026-11-03: Confirmed PA criteria p. 21 (non-preferred criteria): at least 3-month trial and failure, allergy, contraindication or intolerance of 2 preferred agents in any sub-class; the 'any sub-class' wording lets statin or ezetimibe trials count. Preferred generics carry QL only (p. 23). Reasons reworded; no change to picks.]
